panels.title: Online
panels.description: Devices whose last request (sync poll, upload, registration) is within the 'Online = seen within' window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS "online" FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
 AND ud.last_seen_at > now() - '${online_window}'::interval

panels.title: Sign-in sessions created per hour
panels.description: Logins plus refresh-token rotations. Access tokens last 15 minutes, so an app in use rotates a few times an hour: a rough activity signal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(created_at, '1h', 0), count(*) AS "sessions"
FROM auth_sessions
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT ud.platform AS "platform", count(*) AS "devices" FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT ud.platform || ' ' || COALESCE(ud.app_version, '?') AS "version", count(*) AS "devices" FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN ud.os_version ILIKE ud.platform || '%' THEN ud.os_version ELSE ud.platform || ' ' || COALESCE(ud.os_version, '?') END AS "os", count(*) AS "devices" FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(ud.device_model, 'unknown') AS "model", count(*) AS "devices" FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Switches turned on
panels.description: Per-device switches from the app's settings.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.setting AS "setting", count(*) FILTER (WHERE s.enabled) AS "devices"
FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
    ('server push', ud.server_push_enabled), ('cloud sync', ud.cloud_sync_enabled),
    ('bulletin push', ud.bulletin_push_enabled), ('live activity', ud.sync_live_activity),
    ('assignment reminders', ud.sync_assignment_reminders), ('sync courses', ud.sync_courses),
    ('sync course colors', ud.sync_course_colors), ('sync course names', ud.sync_course_names),
    ('sync assignments', ud.sync_assignments)
) AS s(setting, enabled)
WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Push tokens
panels.description: push_to_start tokens start Live Activities; standard tokens carry every other push.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.provider || ' ' || t.token_kind || ' (' || t.status || ')' AS "token", count(*) AS "tokens"
FROM device_push_tokens t
JOIN user_devices ud ON ud.id = t.device_id
JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id
WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT COALESCE(ud.locale, 'unknown') AS "locale", count(*) AS "devices" FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL

panels.title: Devices
panels.description: The portal's device list, plus switches and last-seen. Filtered by the variables above; the search box matches device ID, client ID, student ID and model.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    CASE WHEN ud.last_seen_at > now() - '${online_window}'::interval THEN 'online'
         WHEN ud.last_seen_at > now() - '${active_window}'::interval THEN 'active'
         ELSE 'inactive' END AS "status",
    ud.last_seen_at AS "last seen",
    COALESCE(u.student_id, u.id::text) AS "user",
    ud.platform AS "platform",
    ud.device_model AS "model",
    ud.app_version AS "app",
    ud.os_version AS "os",
    ud.locale AS "locale",
    ud.server_push_enabled AS "push",
    ud.cloud_sync_enabled AS "cloud sync",
    ud.bulletin_push_enabled AS "bulletins",
    ud.sync_live_activity AS "live activity",
    ud.sync_assignment_reminders AS "reminders",
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_push_tokens t WHERE t.device_id = ud.id AND t.status = 'active'
            AND t.provider = 'apns' AND t.token_kind = 'standard') AS "apns",
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_push_tokens t WHERE t.device_id = ud.id AND t.status = 'active'
            AND t.token_kind = 'push_to_start') AS "pts",
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM device_push_tokens t WHERE t.device_id = ud.id AND t.status = 'active'
            AND t.provider = 'fcm') AS "fcm",
    (SELECT t.environment FROM device_push_tokens t WHERE t.device_id = ud.id AND t.status = 'active'
     ORDER BY (t.token_kind = 'standard') DESC, t.id LIMIT 1) AS "apns env",
    ud.last_login_at AS "last login",
    ud.created_at AS "registered",
    ud.id::text AS "device id",
    ud.client_device_id AS "client id"
FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id
WHERE 
ud.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
  AND COALESCE(ud.app_version, 'unknown') IN (${app_version:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = ''
       OR concat_ws(' ', ud.id::text, ud.client_device_id, u.student_id, ud.device_model)
          ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')

ORDER BY ud.last_seen_at DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Device lists
panels.description: Named cohorts for custom pushes, managed from the portal's Lists tab.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.name AS "list", l.description AS "description", count(m.device_id) AS "members",
       l.created_at AS "created", l.updated_at AS "updated"
FROM device_lists l
LEFT JOIN device_list_members m ON m.list_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id
ORDER BY l.name

WITH days AS (
    SELECT generate_series(date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz, 'Asia/Taipei'), $__timeTo()::timestamptz, interval '1 day') AS day
),
counts AS (
SELECT date_trunc('day', ud.created_at, 'Asia/Taipei') AS day, ud.platform AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM user_devices ud JOIN users u ON u.id = ud.user_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(ud.created_at) AND ud.platform IN (${platform:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
),
metrics AS (SELECT DISTINCT metric FROM counts)
SELECT d.day AS "time", m.metric, COALESCE(c.value, 0) AS value
FROM days d
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN counts c ON c.day = d.day AND c.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1
